metadata.section_title: Bar of limitation for imposing penalties.

text:
[Act: income-tax-2025
 Chapter: Penalties
 Section: 472::Bar of limitation for imposing penalties.
]


(1) No order imposing a penalty under this Chapter shall be passed after the expiry of six months from the end of the quarter in which—
  (b) the period commencing on the date on which stay on proceeding for levy of penalty was granted by an order or injunction of any court and ending on the date on which certified copy of the order vacating the stay was received by jurisdictional Principal Commissioner or Commissioner.
